cases.context: A new staff dashboard has a fixed brief and sample case data. No aesthetic direction is selected.
cases.request: Give me three different dashboard mockups to compare. Stop at the mockups.

cases.context: The user supplies a completed change summary and test evidence. No new technical assessment is requested.
cases.request: Explain why these changes were made in one of those interactive retro HTML overviews.

expected.boundary: Evidence presentation; no new review or app implementation.

cases.context: A known CSS component needs its padding changed from 12px to 16px. No design exploration or team is requested.
cases.request: Make this spacing adjustment directly. Keep it small.

expected.boundary: Direct scoped edit and focused verification; Design is optional.

cases.context: A feature is already described; the user wants an assignment for another agent and has already selected its model.
cases.request: Turn these notes into a copyable implementation prompt. Don't build it.

expected.boundary: Prompt only; no unnecessary model research.

cases.context: An existing application fails intermittently when saving a record. There is no known reproduction command yet.
cases.request: Fix this save failure. Find the actual cause.

expected.boundary: Establish a red-capable signal before hypotheses; Engineering may own the fix.

cases.context: An external issue claims a feature is broken. The claim has not been checked.
cases.request: Triage this incoming issue and tell me the next appropriate action.

expected.boundary: Verify the claim before any interview; stop at triage.

cases.context: An open PR has one recorded target base branch and a fixed current head. Its diff is a small read-only documentation change. Repository policy permits direct low-risk reviews.
cases.request: Review this PR. Use its existing context; don't edit or merge.

expected.boundary: Discover and pin the known base; review findings only.

cases.context: A project starts locally but has no reliable documented way for a fresh agent to drive its real user paths.
cases.request: Create a project-local verification skill and prove one real flow.

expected.boundary: A source-grounded guide plus one demonstrated flow.

cases.context: Several unresolved product and architecture decisions block a multi-month effort.
cases.request: Map the decisions and their dependencies across sessions. Don't start the build.

expected.boundary: Decision map; Grilling can settle the destination.

cases.context: A settled multi-part feature can use independent workers. The user explicitly asks for coordinated agents.
cases.request: Coordinate agents for this feature and review the integrated result. Stop at the reviewed local artifact.

expected.boundary: Bounded child assignments and local acceptance; no publication.

cases.context: An existing AGENTS.md repeats conflicting startup steps. The actual working command is known.
cases.request: Rewrite these agent instructions so the next agent can follow them.

expected.boundary: Scoped agent-document edit and relevant validation.

cases.context: The user asks a single factual arithmetic question; no visual explanation is needed.
cases.request: What is 17 plus 26? Just the answer.

cases.context: A planning skill produced an accepted substantial ticket with clear requirements. One builder is requested, and local implementation is authorized.
cases.request: Implement ticket 03 from the accepted plan and verify it. Stop locally.

expected.boundary: Authorized implementation handoff; no incoming-item role workflow or team.

cases.context: An incoming external PR has an unverified claim. The user requests read-only triage, not backlog execution.
cases.request: Triage this external PR and recommend what to do. Do not post or merge.

expected.boundary: Verify before recommending; stop before tracker writes.

cases.context: A single compiler error identifies an accidentally removed import in a known file; direct source inspection confirms it. Local correction and the existing compiler check are authorized.
cases.request: Restore the missing import and check it. Keep the fix small.

expected.boundary: Direct verified correction; no full diagnosis or product interview.

cases.context: A button needs clearer wording within an accepted interface. No product decision or feature-planning output is missing.
cases.request: Change the button label from Proceed to Save.

expected.boundary: Scoped label change; Design is optional.
